title: GBN-AG animal identifier types
description: The kinds of identifier recorded for an individual animal, used as the value space for typeCode on individualTradeProductInstance[].identifier[]. All codes are Defra codes. The $id is the URL the GBN-AG schema already pins identifier urlId to. This file is the working source of truth in the absence of a live Defra reference-data service; when that service goes live, this file is retired and the URL stays the same.
